compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Nothing directly - this is a defect in the document, not in what the agent says. But it means the clause telling the client who to contact about claims may be unreadable, and the client may later say they were never told who their agent was.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client the agreement names their agent.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Give the client your own name, agency and email verbally on the recorded call, and confirm you are their contact for benefit and claims questions. Do not rely on the agreement to have done it.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The FirstEnroll enrollment-agreement template served on the live storefront contains unrendered variables - $parentcompany, $product_label, $agent_fullname, $agent_Email, $parentemail - confirmed on two unrelated product families (American Financial Critical Illness page 38175, and Health Choice Silver page 32339). The affected clauses are the third-party administrator disclaimer, the Plan and Claims Inquiries clause and the Writing Agent Contact block.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Raise with FirstEnroll whether the executed enrollment document renders these variables. See G-039.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Explaining to a client why one of these costs more than another, or recommending an upgrade from Harmony Care to Harmony Care PLUS on the basis of better benefits. No benefit difference is published anywhere.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not describe Harmony Care PLUS as having more benefits than Harmony Care. Do not describe any tier of one family as better than the same tier of another. Do not quote a Harmony Care benefit from the PLUS brochure.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: State the schedule for the specific plan and tier in front of you and nothing more. If a client asks what the difference is between these families, say you will find out - do not improvise one.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Thirty-three live variants across four differently-named families publish one identical benefit set, tier for tier, and one identical 20-state availability list. Harmony Care and Harmony Care PLUS additionally share a single brochure titled for the PLUS product.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: See C-022 and C-023. This needs an answer from FirstEnroll before any comparative statement is made.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Two ways. First, presenting the dental table as dental coverage - it is a discount, the member pays the whole discounted amount. Second, quoting the vision figures as what the client will pay. Those are illustrative examples at five specific stores in five specific cities; a client in another state with a different prescription will see different numbers.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not say dental or vision is covered. Do not quote '$3,549 for child orthodontics' or '$30 for frames at Pearle Vision' as what this client will pay.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: The plan includes dental and vision discount programmes. They are not insurance - they get you a lower price at participating providers, and you pay that price yourself. The figures on the sheet are examples, not quotes.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The Harmony Care and Harmony Care PLUS Info pages carry two DISCOUNT tables - a dental table comparing an 'Aetna regional average cost' to a discounted price, and a vision table listing named retailers in named cities with worked before-and-after prices (Exact Eye Care Kearney NE, LensCrafters Mesa AZ, JC Penney Michigan, Pearle Vision National City CA, EyeMaster Henderson NV).
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Always frame both tables as discounts before quoting any number from them.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

excluded_services.v: Identical exclusion set to Sigma Care PLUS, word for word: not Medically Necessary; not prescribed by a Doctor as necessary to treat Sickness or injury; experimental/investigational except as required by law; received without charge or legal obligation to pay; provided by an immediate family member. Additional, for sickness or injuries caused by: DENTAL PROCEDURES (except accidental injury to sound natural teeth within 12 months, and congenital disease or anomaly; 'Sound Natural Teeth means teeth that are free of active or chronic clinical decay, have at least 50% bone support and are functional in the arch'); ELECTIVE PROCEDURES AND COSMETIC SURGERY with reconstructive exceptions; FELONY OR ILLEGAL OCCUPATION; MANIPULATIONS OF THE MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM; SUICIDE, attempted suicide or intentionally self-inflicted injury 'whether sane or insane'; WAR OR ACT OF WAR, riot, insurrection or any act of armed forces - terrorism not excluded unless the covered person committed it; WORK-RELATED INJURY OR SICKNESS whether or not workers' compensation is payable; PREGNANCY; and VOLUNTARY ABORTION 'except where the Covered Person has a life-threatening condition'.

pre_existing.v: Disclosed twice. Benefit-page footnote: 'There is no coverage for a Pre-existing condition for a continuous period of 12 months following the effective date of a covered person under the Policy.' And in the exclusions as 'Pre-existing Condition Limitation', with the same carve-outs as Sigma Care PLUS: it does not apply to 'the 60 Day period beginning on the date of adoption or filing of a petitioner for adoption' or to a 'newborn or newly adopted child or child under petition for adoption under the age of 18 if the child is enrolled for coverage within 90 Days from the date of birth'.

waiting_period_other.v: 'There is a 30 day waiting period immediately following the Coverage Effective Date; does not apply to an injury.' Restated as 'Sickness Benefit Waiting Period': 'Sickness means an illness, infection, disease, Complication of Pregnancy or any other abnormal physical condition not caused by an Accident.'

addons.questselect_unlimited_labs.v: The brochure bundles a 'QuestSelect - Unlimited Labs Program 2025' by Quest Diagnostics: $0 copay on over 1,000 outpatient lab tests, no deductibles, no copays, no coinsurance, over 2,200 Patient Service Centers, a personalised QuestSelect card in a welcome packet, a Lab Line for redirecting tests, and a patient portal at MyQuestSignup.com. COVERED: blood testing such as cholesterol, urinalysis, pap smears, biopsies, cultures. NOT COVERED: 'Lab work ordered during hospitalization; Lab work needed on an emergency (STAT) basis and time-sensitive, esoteric outpatient laboratory testing such as fertility testing, bone marrow studies, and spinal fluid tests; Non-laboratory work such as mammography, x-ray, imaging, and dental work; Lab work performed without the use of this program; Testing that is not approved and/or covered by current health benefit plan.' Disclaimer: 'This is NOT insurance. This service does not provide money, funds, or any type of reimbursement to pay medical bills. Not all labs are eligible under the $0 co-pay service.' Footnote: 'Provider collection and handling fees may apply.'

extraction_defect.brochure_grid.v: THE BROCHURE'S BENEFIT GRID EXTRACTED WITH A DEMONSTRABLE ROW-SHIFT DEFECT AND NO VALUE HAS BEEN TAKEN FROM IT. The proof is on the face of the extraction: the 'Additional Hospital Admission Benefit / Max Day' row emits the values '- $10,000 $10,000 $10,000 $10,000 $10,000 $10,000 $10,000', which are Accidental Death Benefit amounts appearing on a Max Day row where a day count belongs, and the Accidental Death row then repeats the same figures. Where the grid can be read at all it disagrees with the live portal schedule on the Surgery Benefit at four tiers and on Mental Health at several - the brochure's surgery figures appear shifted one column left of the portal's from the 300 tier upward. That pattern is consistent with the extraction defect rather than with a real benefit difference, but it cannot be resolved from extracted text.
